behavioral.label: Load tasks (hopper_list)
behavioral.evidence: invoke<HopperTaskDto[]>('hopper_list') called on mount and on vox://tasks-changed event

behavioral.label: Add task (TaskComposer onSubmit)
behavioral.evidence: addTask calls invoke('hopper_submit', { intent, affinity: [] }) then refreshes

behavioral.label: Reprioritize task (priority select onChange)
behavioral.evidence: onChange calls reprioritize() which calls invoke('hopper_reprioritize', { itemId, priority })

behavioral.label: Session filter pills onClick
behavioral.evidence: setSessionFilter(sid) is meaningful local state that gates filteredRows; no backend needed

behavioral.label: Show blocked tasks checkbox onChange
behavioral.evidence: setShowBlocked(e.target.checked) is meaningful local filter state

behavioral.label: Description span onClick (focus file in Ludus)
behavioral.evidence: Calls useLudusStore.getState().setFocusedFile() only when write_files is non-empty; guard is correct but backend DTO maps write_files=[] always (line 79), so this branch is currently unreachable with live data

behavioral.label: Form onSubmit / Add button onClick
behavioral.evidence: handleSubmit validates non-empty then calls props.onSubmit(trimmed) which maps to addTask → invoke('hopper_submit')

visual.issue: Priority select uses hardcoded Tailwind colors 'bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-100' instead of design-system tokens (bg-bg-base / text-text-primary)
'text-amber-400' hardcoded for blocked badge; should use a semantic token
Overlap warning badge uses hardcoded 'border-amber-400/30 bg-amber-400/10 text-amber-300' instead of ds tokens
Remote mesh badge uses hardcoded 'border-cyan-400/30 bg-cyan-400/10 text-cyan-300' instead of ds tokens
Form container uses 'bg-white/[0.02] border-white/10' arbitrary bracket value instead of ds overlay tokens
Textarea uses hardcoded 'text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-600' instead of text-text-primary / text-text-muted
Cancel-task Button contains only an Icon (Icon.x) with no visible text label. It has title="Cancel task" but no aria-label attribute; title is not reliably exposed to screen readers
Description span is interactive (onClick, cursor-pointer, hover style) but is a <span> not a <button>; no role, no keyboard activation support
Priority column has fixed width=110 which may clip the 'Background' option label on some locales or font sizes
Task ID column has fixed width=80; UUID-style IDs truncated to 8 chars which is fine, but the fixed width leaves no flex room
The only row-level action is Cancel (destructive). There is no primary action (e.g. view detail, open in agent); unclear hierarchy — the only affordance is destructive
